notes: The East Kolkata Wetlands lie outside KMC, in North and South 24 Parganas. The city's largest sewage treatment asset is not inside the city.

Even if every upcoming STP is built, 280.06 MLD of new capacity against 311 MLD currently untreated leaves a residual gap of 30.94 MLD - and that assumes the wetlands keep treating 910 MLD, which the plan takes as given.
KMC's Environment Plan leaves the entire industrial-wastewater section blank, naming WBPCB as the responsible agency. That is the corporation declaring a gap in its own statutory plan.
